leadHtml:
VIEW CANVAS V0.27.0 ALPHA

@fzlt/core/view-canvas

One overlay canvas per root, sized for the screen's pixel density and redrawn only where something changed. The canvas covers the root's padding box (pointer-events: none, so the root keeps its input), its backing store is the CSS size × devicePixelRatio (capped by maxDpr), and drawing is in CSS px. - Dirty redraw: dirty([x, y, w, h]) grows one box (no arguments: the whole canvas); in the render phase that box, snapped out to whole device pixels, is cleared, clipped and handed to draw. Nothing dirty, nothing drawn: a still view costs no canvas work at all. - Settle: it never keeps the engine awake; dirty() wakes a settled engine for one redraw. - Layout reads only in the read phase, and only after a resize or a zoom (a ResizeObserver). - Recall: the canvas goes and the root's style comes back exactly (the engine's ledger). It has no motion of its own: reduced motion belongs to whatever moves the drawing.

ViewCanvasOptions interface ALPHA

Options for viewCanvas: the draw callback, the density cap and an accessible name.

export interface ViewCanvasOptions {
    /** Paint. The canvas is already cleared and clipped to `box` ([x, y, w, h], CSS px): draw the
     *  scene (anything outside the box is clipped away, so drawing it all is fine). */
    draw(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, box: Float64Array): void;
    /** The most pixel density drawn (default 2: sharp on a phone, a quarter of the pixels at 4×). */
    maxDpr?: number;
    /** An accessible name: the canvas becomes role="img" (default: aria-hidden, decoration). */
    label?: string;
}

viewCanvas function ALPHA

One overlay canvas on root, sized for the pixel density (capped by maxDpr) and redrawn only inside the dirty box: dirty([x, y, w, h]) (CSS px), or dirty() for all of it. Never keeps the engine awake; Recall removes the canvas and gives the root's style back.

    /** Redraw box [x, y, w, h] (CSS px) on the next render; no box, the whole canvas. The box comes
     *  in an array, not as four numbers: doubles passed to a call are boxed. Wakes a settled engine. */

        readonly [i: number]: number;
    }): void;
    read(): void;

};
